items: 1 Tbsp active dry yeast
1/4 cup warm water
1/2 cup butter or margarine
3/4 cup milk
1/2 cup sugar
3 eggs, beaten
3/4 tsp salt
4 to 4 1/2 cups flour, scooped
1/2 cup melted butter
Combine yeast and warm water; allow to stand 5 minutes until it foams, then stir down.
Melt butter in pan. Add milk immediately and remove from heat.
Blend in sugar, eggs, salt, and dissolved yeast.
Stir in enough flour to make soft dough. Cover and allow to rise until double.
Turn dough (which is very soft and should remain so) onto floured board. Knead slightly to handle.
Divide in half. Roll each half into a circle 12 to 14 inches in diameter.
Spread with softened or melted butter. Cut pie fashion into 16 pieces.
Roll each piece from large end to pointed tip. Place point down on baking sheet.
Repeat with 2nd half of dough.
Let rise until double. Bake at 375°F for 12 to 15 minutes.
Can be frozen. If so, let rise until double and bake as usual.
